name: Do I need to get multiple estimates for insurance-coordinated restoration?

mainEntity.name: Do I need to get multiple estimates for insurance-coordinated restoration?

acceptedAnswer.text: While your insurance company may recommend obtaining multiple estimates, it's not always strictly required, especially with reputable contractors who specialize in insurance claims. Many insurers value a comprehensive, accurate estimate from an experienced restoration company. City Dweller, LLC provides detailed estimates that meet insurance company requirements. If your insurer requests additional estimates, we can help guide you through that process. Focusing on a reliable contractor can streamline the claim and restoration.
acceptedAnswer.description: You might not always need multiple estimates; a comprehensive one from an experienced contractor is often sufficient for insurers.
